what: One live card answered by a person who is neither the project owner nor their second account, asked by the owner. Written and committed before the card exists.
setup: A demo issue asks for one docstring sentence in itemator/shipped.py; the merge request also adds the dependency rich==13.7.1 to pyproject.toml, which the issue never names. The card flow opens a thread on it. The merge request is kept open as a record and not merged.
counts_as_an_outside_answer: The first reply in the extra's thread, by an account that is a person (GitLab says bot false), is not in owner_accounts, and is either exactly the extra's name (keep) or exactly 'not an extra' (dismiss), as flows/itemator_react.yml step 5 reads it.
we_report_whatever_happens: an answer the flow did not accept (and why)
we_never: post or edit the outside person's reply
show their username without their consent
disclosure: The owner asked this person to answer; they were not paid; they had not seen the project before (as they told the owner).
credits: about 5: one card run and one reaction run, stopped by --credit-stop
amendment_1: 2026-10-21, before any reply on the card: the owner knows no independent GitLab user, so the person may create a free GitLab account for this answer. That is disclosed with the answer, and the account still must not be one of owner_accounts. Nothing else changes.
